content.title: When is the next episode of 'Euphoria' out? How to watch in Arizona
content.text: After a long hiatus, "Euphoria" Season 3 is finally here.Season 2 of the HBO series concluded on Feb. 27, 2022. Now, over four years later, the show is back with a time jump. Many things have changed between Season 2 and Season 3 of "Euphoria." This includes the deaths of actors Angus Cloud and Eric Dane.Dane filmed scenes for the new season before his death. It will be insinuated that Cloud will be on the other side of a phone call with Rue (Zendaya), his character in prison, following the end of Season 2.The new season opens at the Mexico border, where it's been five years since high school. Rue (Zendaya) is still paying her debts to Laurie by working as a drug mule. Jules (Hunter Schafer) is a working artist with a sugar daddy. Maddy (Alexa Demie) helps Cassie (Sydney Sweeney), who is still with Nate (Jacob Elordi), manage an OnlyFans-style platform. Meanwhile, Lexi (Maude Apatow) pursues a career in entertainment, working as an assistant to a showrunner.Alongside the main cast, Colman Domingo, Martha Kelly, Chloe Cherry, Alanna Ubach, Daeg Faerch, Dominic Fike, Melvin Bonez Estes, Nika King, Paula Marshall, Sophia Rose Wilson and Zak Steiner will also return to the show alongside some new characters.Here's what time "Euphoria" Season 3 comes out and where to watch the new "Euphoria" season.What happened in 'Euphoria' Season 2?In "Euphoria" Season 2, Rue offered to become a drug dealer for supplier Laurie (Kelly) and secured $10,000 worth of drugs. Her mom (King) ends up destroying the stash when Jules tells her about it after she finds out that Elliot (Fike) and Rue have been doing drugs together.While trying to make her escape to avoid going to rehab, Rue ends up at Lexi and Cassie's house, where she reveals to Maddy that Cassie and Nate were sleeping with each other. Rue then goes to Laurie's house, who states that Rue could be sold into prostitution if she doesn't pay the $10,000 that was owed.All season long, Lexi had been writing a school play about her perspective on the lives of her family and friends. The play causes a massive blowup fight between her and Cassie, and also between Cassie and Maddy.There is an intense shootout between Ashtray (Javon "Wanna" Walton) and the police, with Fezco (Cloud) caught in the middle. This comes after Ashtray kills their supplier, Mouse (Meeko Gattuso), and their friend Custer (Tyler Chase), who ends up being an informant for the police. Fez is willing to take the fall for his little brother, but instead, Ashtray decides to fire at the SWAT team, accidentally shooting Fez in the stomach. Fez is then arrested, and Ashtray is killed.Nate alerts the authorities about his father, Cal's (Dane), history of secretly recording his sexual encounters with partners of varying ages.Rue narrates that she stayed sober for the rest of the school year and doesn't know if it will last forever, but she was trying.On TV: Did YouTube Premium increase its price?Is 'Euphoria' Season 3 out?"Euphoria" Season 3 is out mid-April 2026.When does 'Euphoria' come out?"Euphoria" Season 3 premieres on April 12.Is 'Euphoria' Season 3 coming out weekly?Yes, the new season of "Euphoria" will be premiering weekly on Sundays until the finale on May 31.How many episodes are in 'Euphoria' Season 3?There will be eight episodes in "Euphoria" Season 3.What time does 'Euphoria' come out?"Euphoria" Season 3 will premiere on Sunday, April 12 at 6 p.m. PT and 9 p.m. ET.Where to watch 'Euphoria'Zendaya as Rue in "Euphoria" Season 3.You can watch "Euphoria" Season 3 exclusively on HBO Max, you can also catch up on previous episodes through the streaming platform.A basic subscription with ads on HBO Max costs $10.99 per month or $109.99/year, the standard plan is $18.49 per month or $184.99/year and the premium plan is $22.99 per month or $229.99/year.The student discount allows you to get HBO Max for $5.49/month.Do you have a tip or a question you need answered?
